annotations.title: Approve, skip or edit an action

description: Decide one action: approve, skip or edit its draft. Approving runs it as the product's owner and publishes or sends through the accounts connected on hustlin.ai. The founder's own post (queue_post) with a scheduledFor still ahead is the exception: approving keeps it waiting and it posts at that time (delivery scheduled, with publishAt); run posts it now. Pass when: scheduled to have any other post wait for its scheduledFor the same way. Needs the approver role or higher.

content.description: Replacement draft text. Required for edit, optional with approve.

decision.description: approve: ship it now (publishes or sends through connected accounts; manual tasks stay guidance). skip: don't do it. edit: change the draft without approving.

when.description: With approve. now (default): publish or send at once, even ahead of its scheduledFor. scheduled: a post Hustlin publishes waits for its scheduledFor and goes out then (delivery scheduled, with publishAt); with no date ahead it goes out at once.
